apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run when the Actor starts.

navigation-area-check.eventDescription: One point, route or bounding-box check against the official USCG NAVCEN MSI layers. Charged once per run when all requested layers were checked (including zero matches), or when matching notices were found although some layers could not be checked. Not charged for invalid input, or when coverage is incomplete and nothing was found.
